description: Database Topografico - TEMA: STRADE is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Basilicata. Si identifica la "strada" come l'area ad uso pubblico destinata alla circolazione dei pedoni, dei veicoli e degli animali. Nel tema sono descritte le aree di mobilità sia principale che secondaria e la corrispondente rappresentazione a grafo. Coverage: Regione Basilicata. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Basilicata. Its tags are basilicata, carta-tecnica, cartografia, cartografia-di-base, ciclabile. It offers 48 resource(s) in KML, WMS, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-01-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is IODL-2.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
